description: This file is a shell script for resolving git merge conflicts, implementing various merging strategies, conflict resolution prompts, and integration with other git components.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Checks if the given mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Checks if the given mode indicates a git submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if the local mode variable is set, indicating the presence of local changes.

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if the remote mode variable is set, indicating the presence of remote changes.

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if the base mode variable is set, indicating the presence of a base version.

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes temporary directory for merge tools, either using config or mktemp.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during merge operations, optionally saving backups.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Describes the file status based on mode, branch, and filename.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflict resolution for symbolic link conflicts by prompting user.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving deleted files, prompting user for action.

methods.name: resolve_submodule_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts for submodules, prompting user.

methods.name: stage_submodule
methods.description: Stages submodules by updating git index.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a specific staged file from index.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Prepares the file by merging 'ours' and 'theirs' versions for conflict resolution.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function for merging a file, handling conflict detection, description, and invoking the merge tool.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Prompts user to continue merging after a failure.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Prints message when no files need merging and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main driver function that orchestrates the merging process, handling command-line args and invoking merge_file per file.
